steps.name: Wounded Moon (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Argent] in 「Sanctuary Eidos」, defeat [Barvatos] in 「Sanctuary of the Covenant」 and obtain <Black Butterfly Corpse>. Then report to [Dana] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Who is there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wish you would let your guard down... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Sorry. A powerful energy approached me and I thought it was an enemy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As Barbatos retreats, all the ominous energy seems to have disappeared. Can you feel something?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No. I think I was mistaken. So what brought you back to the sanctuary?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just wanted to come here one more time.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: So you're saying there's no real reason. All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Seeing as Argent is here without returning, have you met them yet?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, His Majesty said that things are fine with them, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It wasn't anything special, but there was something I wanted to find personally, so I looked around the sanctuary of the covenant. I'm sure it exists, but I couldn't find it.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A black butterfly is hovering around the sanctuary... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I saw it when Barbatos disappeared. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, that's right... . That butterfly was there even when I guided the youngest princess.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: If that's the case, I think we'll know what Barbatos was doing. And we may be able to find evidence of those who attempted treason at that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll take a look. Since you trust me, I will help you.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Thank you. If you have trouble with the Empire in the future, I will help you. I will return the favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's just a matter of finding a butterfly, but it's grace... . are you okay. Anyway, I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: And I would like you to bring that butterfly to the princess as soon as you find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person is the princess? Ah, you are Dana.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, then please take care of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like the atmosphere in the sanctuary has changed for a moment as we talk about butterflies... shall we go first?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. %s, what is that? Do you have something for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent told me to find this and give it to Mr. Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Argent is really the same now and then... . I just need to worry about my sister... . Phew… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ah, this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the black butterfly that hovered next to Barbatos. They said that if I had it, I could find evidence of things that happened in the past.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's right. Actually, I've been looking for this for a long time. So I kept going to find the other side.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There was no trace of Barbatos as he had not been seen during this time. Then he appeared in the sanctuary... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for discovering the other side of the sanctuary. But this is it.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It looks like a butterfly, but it's actually a model, right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It seems like there's some kind of spell that affects time and space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what should I do?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I need someone's help. About time and space… . Oh, Principal Cloris won't do it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, Siam….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe I can get some advice.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay, then let me ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I guess Siam will be fine...?)

steps.name: Wounded Moon (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Siam] in “The World Between Times” and obtain <Hourglass of Tears>. Then report to [Dana] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Nice to meet you. I also needed someone to talk to today, so you came at the right time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should we talk about? What was it like where you originally lived?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: It was a place as beautiful and bright as Gndia, and people walked around smiling brightly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like a nice and beautiful place to live.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: That's right. There was a restaurant famous for noodle dishes… . Ah, now that I think about it, my memories of that place are becoming increasingly blurry. I want to see it again, but I can't... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Haha, I actually don't regret losing my eyesight, but I still have to brag about it.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: My eyesight is so good that my left and right eyes are 4.0 each. As I practiced magic and concentrated, my eyesight also improved.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Hahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I also have good eyesight, but I don't think it's to that extent... .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: You do not have a better mind's eye. So it's okay.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: By the way… . Iris Are you still smiling? Of course you should, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Iris is… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Now, tell me why you came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Siam about the black butterfly.)

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: I want what I have. Is that okay? I don't know if it will help, but give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Siam.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Instead, take it after you spar with me. I just wanted to relax a bit. I need to get ready, so I'd like you to leave and come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Then take it and leave right away without saying anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: Take my word for it and do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go out and come back again.

lines.speaker: 사이암
lines.text: (Time and space are shaking... I guess we should stop first...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana, you are there. I brought something that might help. But why is your expression like that?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's because it feels familiar. Now that I think about it, this thing, an hourglass… . It seems like something from another world... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … By any chance, Iris is it from the wizard at the party?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I see. But I feel like I've been discovered behind the scenes... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thanks for saving me. Let me take a look.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: To my knowledge, I don't know. I thought experience would tell everything, but I guess I'll have to leave this to someone who knows better than me.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, did you feel anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A bit vise… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That person from Eastland. Just a guess on my part, that guy. Are you related to someone named Daphne?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . little… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I see. I think I can find some clues now. Thank you, and I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: This is something we sisters should do, but I think %s might get involved again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I will help too. But where do we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'm not sure. Wouldn’t you go there again if someone calls you?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe, yeah. okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dana. See you later. Then, let’s have a quick meal… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is it so cold all of a sudden? It feels like I've been to a frozen world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, it must be my mood. Phew… . Yeah, nothing will happen.
